title: Do not decorate the life that forgot the Beloved
summary: This meets the life still polished on the outside while divided within. The line says without the Shabad and the Husband Lord, every decoration stays false.
takeaway: Let the Shabad reach deeper than display.
lifeApplication: Before fixing the surface again, ask what in you still loves duality. Let one line undo more vanity than another layer can hide.

source.shortMeaning: A life deceived by duality cannot be beautified from the outside.
source.lifeApplication: When you reach for another surface fix, ask what the Shabad still needs to heal.
